source: owner answers in chat (AskUserQuestion, 3 rounds), after reading DIRECTION-20261117-BRIDGERET-HANDOFF.md

decisions.O2_p1_test_rule: the last 10,000 tasks of filing year 2012 in reverse order of sha256('p2-oa-split-v1|' + app_id); P2-TEST takes the first n of the same order; no overlap
decisions.O3_base_model: Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v2.0 (Apache-2.0); Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B only as a recorded fallback
decisions.O4_denoise: reranker denoise (S4c); rule-only kept as an ablation
decisions.O5_dapfam_single_look: yes, LOCAL ONLY (dr-train or this PC, never RunPod), on the frozen checkpoint, labelled external/exploratory because the DAPFAM test was opened once by P1-DAPFAM
decisions.O6_budget_tier: A+ : USD 175 total = API 100 + GPU 75 (P1 core about 29; the P2 reranker FT is replaced by the P1 retriever)
decisions.O7_publish: yes, after the licence check (O8): IDs, split manifests and scripts only, no patent text
decisions.O10_ft_method: full fine-tuning by default; LoRA only as a fallback if VRAM or cost forces it, and the switch is recorded
decisions.runpod_method: RunPod MCP via hosted OAuth; every create/delete/billing action needs the owner's approval in the client; no API key stored in files or logs
decisions.r5_text_download: approved with a 60 GB cap: list the exact PatentsView text/claims files (pre-grant and grant) and their sizes first and record them, then download only what fits under 60 GB to dr-train /data/ptp-paper2/
decisions.fine_tuning_allowed: yes, for P1-BridgeRet only (lifts the old 'no training' rule for this study), within Tier A+ and the pre-declaration
proposals_accepted: 1: names P1-DAPFAM (closed; keep as a short pre-registered negative report or as motivation) and P1-BridgeRet
2: unseen-doc subset reported alongside the primary result, with a pre-declared no-sign-flip rule
3: free V100 for encoding and mining; RunPod mainly for fine-tuning
4: every zero-shot baseline uses its developer-recommended query/document prompts

still_open.O8_licence_check: a task, not a choice: verify the Arctic, PatentsView and OA dataset licences before any release (G1.5)
still_open.O9_OAER: stays a secondary setting, as in plan v2; the exact AIA/pre-AIA rule text must be verified before the P2 freeze
still_open.api_first_envelope: P1 uses no API. Before the first OpenRouter call (P2/P3), the exact model IDs, provider and per-dispatch cap still need owner approval
still_open.per_dispatch_caps: Tier A+ is the ceiling, not permission for unbounded runs; the RunPod pilot keeps its USD 10 cap; later RunPod jobs record an expected cost and stop before it
